family.description: This cyanobacterial family of fatty aldehyde decarbonylases acts on mainly C16 and C18 substrates to form hydrocarbons and carbon monoxide [[cite:PUB00055010]]. Note that the corresponding EC number ([ec:4.1.99.5]) dating from 1989 refers to a nonorthologous Pisum sativum enzyme that acts on C18 and longer chains and attaches the overly narrow narrow name octadecanal decarbonylase.
family.name: Long-chain fatty aldehyde decarbonylase
